items.html: No release mechanics — tracking the release obligation and actually releasing the worktree/branch/session is the teardown slice → LC2

No workflow actions — author-chosen type: action steps (the automated human_gate sibling) over the L2a runner family, distinct from LC2's provider resource teardown: LC3a the commit/merge actions (operator-triggered — MVP), LC3b the general library + auto trigger (perf-test, publish, notify) → LC3a / LC3b
No archive / export / purge / retention — optional cold ops, computed from the durable record, never the preservation path nor a teardown precondition → LC4 (~L8 ops)
No storage-backend choice — file vs object store vs DB for T1/T3 is an implementation concern; this slice fixes placement & authority, not the medium → impl
No multi-instance / federation storage or central registry/store governance — a single run's homes only; cross-run/central stores are later → L11+

No durable-write mechanism — v3 already treats transcript/instance as durable abstract stores; this slice makes the boundary + the evidence-ref rule explicit, it does not re-implement the store → impl
No computed / templated evidence bodies or evidence-blob GC — referenced blobs are write-once durable; lifecycle/retention of the T3 store is LC4 → LC4
